use serde_json::Value;

pub fn solve(input: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
    let mut total_length = 0;
    for interval in input.as_array() {
        let start = interval[0].as_i64().unwrap();
        let end = interval[1].as_i64().unwrap();
        total_length += (end - start) as i64;
    }
    serde_json::Value::Number(total_length as f64)
}
